name: Nationalpark Camping Großglockner
beschreibung: Nationalpark Camping Großglockner welcomes outdoor enthusiasts to Kals am Großglockner in East Tyrol, located at the core of the Hohe Tauern National Park. Surrounded by the towering three-thousand-metre peaks of the Glockner Range, it delivers an unforgettable wilderness experience in a peaceful valley landscape. Terraced pitches for motorhomes, caravans, and tents afford uninterrupted panoramas of glaciated summits and alpine pastures. Amenities include modern heated sanitary facilities, boot drying facilities, and a kiosk stocking regional delicacies. Epic alpine climbs and leisurely valley hikes begin right from the campsite, with the Großglockner Resort ski area nearby in winter.
kurzbeschreibung: High-alpine campsite in Kals am Großglockner in the Hohe Tauern National Park facing the Glockner range.
